commits_this_run.subject: docs(nexus): promote NEX-076 to VERIFIED after a 4/4 green CI read

decisions_this_run: D-076a: the rationale column is nullable because it mirrors granted_by. A human-issued grant must carry a reason; a configuration grant must not. One pairing invariant in the domain, not two independent optional fields.

D-076b: no backfill. Every pre-existing row is a configuration grant by construction (the human write path did not exist before NEX-074), so inventing a reason would fabricate an audit fact. A check constraint forbids the empty string so 'no record' and 'a record that says nothing' stay distinguishable.
D-076c: one bound constant applied by both the request schema (422 at the boundary) and the domain value object (safe for non-HTTP callers), so the two cannot drift.
run_summary: Run 76 took the first of the two follow-ups the run-75 checkpoint named: persist an operator-grant rationale. NEX-074 had deliberately omitted the field because the row had no column for it, so a required free-text field would have been validated and discarded - a record that reads as evidence but is never written. NEX-076 adds the column (migration b4e6f1a2c9d7, nullable, non-empty check constraint), the OperatorGrantRationale value object, a domain pairing invariant (human-issued grants must state a reason; configuration grants must not), the required request field, and the router wiring. 18 new tests across four layers; full suite 1569 passed / 4 skipped; ruff format+check and mypy (143 files) clean. CI on the docs head 4fa0463 came back 4/4 completed/success, so NEX-076 is VERIFIED. PR #5's body now carries NEX-052..NEX-076. One test-fixture bug is recorded in the execution log: a helper that joins one user's scopes into a single comma-joined entry is only correct for one scope, and passing two produced a scope string that exceeded the parser's limit and failed the app build - a fixture misunderstanding that looked like a domain bug.

head_drift_policy: `commit` names the last head whose *product* code was verified by CI, not necessarily the branch tip.
